    dadr = np.array([m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}').dofadr[0] for i in range(1, 8)])

    m, d = s.model, s.data
    site = s.env.robots[0].eef_site_id['right']
    qa, da = arm_addresses(s)
    q0 = d.qpos[qa].copy()

        er = Rotation.from_matrix(np.asarray(R_goal) @ R.T).as_rotvec()
        e = np.r_[ep, er]
